stories.title: Inflation moderated last week as Intel and Nvidia drove the AI trade
stories.summary: CNBC reports that inflation data came in cooler last week, giving markets room to run, while Intel and Nvidia led another leg of the AI-stock rally. The combination of easing price pressure and strength in chipmakers set the tone for trading through the week.
stories.whyItMatters: Softer inflation readings feed directly into Fed rate expectations, while Intel and Nvidia's moves remain a bellwether for how much further the AI trade can carry the broader market.
whatToWatch: Whether upcoming inflation prints continue to moderate
Nvidia and Intel's next earnings or guidance updates
How the Fed characterizes the recent data in coming commentary
questions: Is the inflation moderation broad-based or concentrated in a few categories?
How much of the market's gains are now dependent on just a handful of AI-linked names?

stories.title: US Strategic Petroleum Reserve nears levels that raise storage-cavern concerns
stories.summary: CNBC reports the Strategic Petroleum Reserve has been drawn down close to a level that is starting to raise concerns about damage to the underground salt caverns used to store the oil, as well as broader operational issues. The reserve has been depleted following years of releases.
stories.whyItMatters: The SPR is a key buffer against oil-price shocks, and questions about its physical capacity to hold or release crude could affect how markets price supply risk.
whatToWatch: Any government plans to begin refilling the reserve
Details on cavern integrity or operational assessments
Oil price reaction if refill or repair plans are announced
questions: How low can the reserve go before physical damage becomes a real constraint?
Would repairs or refilling be a multi-year, market-moving undertaking?
